state.goal: Resolve original CanShift duty_notice to intended event.recipient without exposing arbitrary user.email or weakening source send guard/current permission/recovery. Finite complete mail effect support, no directory-returning primitive or new notification subsystem.
state.verified_source: CanShift trusted duty_notice handler actor=null sends Mail.send {to=event.recipient.email,subject=format(fixed localized message),body=format(fixed localized message)} when=active_member(event.recipient,team) and exact current duty/roster revision/kind/eligibility/conflict/swap predicates; then creates Notice {parent=event.duty,recipient=event.recipient,revision,kind,delivery}. Preserve recipient, dispatch predicate/order, delivery association and Notice.
verified_mechanisms: Canonical std.EmailV1.send accepts to:email,subject:text,body:text,attachments:file[] and EmailAccepted. No source user mail operation currently exists. Identity privately has findUserById; user.email deliberately forbidden except authenticated actor.email. Trusted handler actor is null, so source substitution is invalid.

Existing bound-mail adapter validates exact emitted binding/capability/version/operation schema and routes to installed Services MailSender. available() is synchronous closed shape/binding admission before guard/claim; it must not resolve directory. Work native dispatcher owns current source guard, claim, revalidation, provider result/unknown handling and canonical delivery identity.

Ordinary email address is frozen in original durable outbox arguments. Services FrozenMailRequest is ONLY per-call memory; resolving a user email afresh in adapter.send after timeout could reroute an original uncertain send. Reconcile already uses original delivery ID without address/arguments.

Existing Work dispatch row owns private image/text control pins under held-claim commands; transitions preserve private row data. A named closed user-recipient pin in that existing row, committed immutably under exact held claim after guard success and before network, can freeze intended user/team/address once. Crash before pin => no network, after pin => reuse address; unknown/reconcile retain delivery ID and pinned request. Current membership revalidation gates any new send attempt; reconciliation may observe already accepted outcome after revocation.

Native source SEND currently constructs ordinary source args eagerly; private directory resolution must therefore occur at guarded dispatch, not in a source to=email helper. Original to=user reference + fixed message formatting have no directory effect. Do not widen arbitrary user field read or add address-returning values. Existing source guard remains authoritative and exact original current-team selected-user membership is additionally required for the private recipient operation. Missing/inactive/foreign/unverified user refuses or yields explicit safe failure before transport, never redirects/omits successful notice.
state.acceptance: Original notice names exact user target and source guard. False guard makes zero directory/provider calls; legitimate current same-team member resolves privately only after true guard/claim. Missing/unverified/removed/foreign recipient cannot send. No email enters source/Notice/result/error. Immutable private pin and same provider request/delivery survive crash/unknown/email change and reconcile without re-resolution or duplicate wrong recipient. Legacy address send and binding/target/version/refusal checks unchanged. Original CRM24source composition compiles; native pipeline negative/recovery checks pass.
state.choice_scope: Choose source contract form. Every candidate must implement same private Work pin, guard/current-membership, binding, privacy and recovery obligations; none is a typing-only workaround.

recipient_contract.instructions: Which source-level mail contract best completes the original user-targeted duty notice with the smallest permission-preserving implementation?

criteria.add_user_operation: Add additive std.EmailV1.send_user(to:user,subject,body,attachments)->EmailAccepted alongside unchanged send(to:email). Both use existing explicitly installed EmailV1 transport binding; operation target/delivery association remain exact and distinct. Minimal single user-targeted effect, adds canonical operation/catalog/adapter handling and private Work pin.
criteria.separate_user_capability: Introduce std.UserEmailV1.send(to:user,...)->EmailAccepted with explicitly installed versioned user-recipient binding backed by same address transport and private Work pin. Keeps EmailV1 contract frozen and authority explicit, but new capability/binding manifest/configuration and target family are needed for one demonstrated use.
criteria.union_existing_to: Extend existing EmailV1.send.to to email|user with tagged canonical wire admission and private user resolution/pin on user arm. Keeps same authored operation but expands current contract input domain, schema/codec/correspondence compatibility and delivery interpretation; ensure old email path unchanged.
